name: triplet
title: Triplet distance
description: Number of leaf triples resolved differently by the two trees. Finer-grained than Robinson-Foulds, which judges a whole clade present or absent; a triple disagreement is a smaller unit than a clade, so this does not saturate on large clades the way RF does. Computed by TreeDiff's trip_sht program, run as a separate process. TreeDiff was released with Branco, Vaz & Francisco (2024), but that paper covers Robinson-Foulds only; no publication describes its triplet programs.

reference.citation: TreeDiff (trip_sht). Open-source C++ tool; its triplet programs are not described in a publication.

summary.label: Triplet distance
summary.description: Leaf triples on which the two trees disagree, out of C(n,3) possible.
